title: Prenuvo MRI intro
description: A black section that rises over the pinned hero: a large machine image (filling the window height on desktop, wider than the screen on phones) and, across its foot, three centred features, each with a glowing coloured dot, a semibold title and a short muted line. The section fades up from near-black as it arrives, and the features rise 80px into place one after another.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); made to follow prenuvo-hero, which it slides over
media is the machine image (1330×936 on desktop, contain); empty shows a placeholder of that shape
dot colours: chart-1, chart-2, chart-3 (green, blue, lilac in the prenuvo theme)
name: prenuvo-mri
